verdicts.explanation: The paper states Ag2Ni2TeO6 has a conductivity of 4.88 × 10−4 S cm−1 at 30 °C, from its own EIS measurements, and describes it as the bulk ionic conductivity. The 0.57 eV activation energy, ~84% pellet compactness, and non-sintered cold-pressed pellets are all stated for this material.

The paper reports Ag2Mg2TeO6 with 1.77 × 10−6 S cm−1 at 30 °C from its own measurements, with a pellet density of ~74%. No activation energy or sintering conditions are given for it, so the nulls are correct.
